_comment: South Florida seed set -- Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach.
Purpose is as much a CRAWLABILITY TEST as a data pull. Tampa Bay died on
robots.txt: 6 of its best sources were disallowed, and that was only
discovered by running the harvest. Nobody can read robots.txt from the dev
sandbox, so this seed set exists to let the GitHub runner answer the
question with evidence instead of inference.
The structural bet: Miami-Dade high schools run INDEPENDENT vanity domains
subdomains, so a restrictive district robots.txt would govern none of them.
Palm Beach has pushed bulletins onto Google Sites, which is crawler-friendly.
Both claims are untested until this runs.

seeds.org: Coral Reef Senior High CAP Corner
seeds.note: Reported to link 300+ postsecondary scholarship opportunities. Highest award-density single URL found in the region. Independent domain, not dadeschools.net.
24 named funds, $3.26M awarded 2025 across students from 76 high schools.

seeds.org: Coral Gables Community Foundation 2025 awards list
seeds.note: Publishes actual award/recipient lists -- unusually good structured data, and a rare source of num_awards.
Google Site, free, no login. Hand-maintained, mixed local/national.

seeds.org: Community Foundation of Broward administered scholarships
seeds.note: Named funds, $1,000 one-year up to $20,000 four-year.
Nov 1 - Apr 1. Also administers Community Foundation of Broward's awards, making it a single door for two funders.

seeds.org: Broward League of Cities scholarship program

seeds.note: $7.5M to 400+ students. Restricted to seniors who both RESIDE and ATTEND SCHOOL in Broward or Palm Beach -- exactly the bi-county restriction a national database cannot express.

seeds.org: Palm Beach County district scholarship bulletin hub
seeds.note: The only one of the three districts that centralizes per-school bulletins. Best single entry point in the tri-county area.

seeds.org: Park Vista Community High School bulletin
seeds.note: Named awards with amounts. Tests whether school SUBDOMAINS serve their own robots.txt separately from the district.

seeds.org: Palm Beach per-school bulletin on Google Sites
seeds.note: Google Sites sidesteps district robots.txt entirely. If this works it is the template for per-school coverage.

seeds.org: Community Foundation for Palm Beach & Martin Counties
seeds.note: 140+ awards, ~$12,000 average, $1.7M cycle. ONE general application auto-considers for 120+. Window Feb 2 - Mar 4.

seeds.org: Education Foundation of Palm Beach County

seeds.note: Boca Raton and Delray Beach high schools only. 25-30 seniors/yr, up to $10k/yr for 4 years.
